claude.sample_unit: responses (48 questions each under two prompts)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of GPT-5 responses relative to recommended patient-education thresholds
links.effect: Patient-focused prompt reduced reading grade level significantly (P < 0.001), but the resulting grade level remained above widely recommended patient-education thresholds.
links.quote: Patient-focused prompting substantially reduced the linguistic complexity and reading grade level of GPT-5 Thinking responses without a statistically significant reduction in expert-rated accuracy, demonstrating its ability to produce more accessible breast imaging content, although the resulting grade level remained above widely recommended patient-education thresholds.

links.outcome: Readability and expert-rated accuracy of AI patient education responses under standard vs patient-focused prompts
links.effect: Prompt 2 had significantly lower reading levels across all indices (P < 0.001); accuracy comparable (4.54 ± 0.63 vs 4.52 ± 0.59, P = 0.75).
links.quote: The mean accuracy scores remained high and comparable between prompts for all questions (4.54 ± 0.63 vs. 4.52 ± 0.59, P = 0.75).
